contributions.detail: The 23 rows of the attached typed Schedule A ledger (p4) sum to 1000.00+50+100+35+50+100+25+50+100+25+200+40+50+50+25+30+25+100+40+100+25+100+120 = 2,440.00 exactly. That equals the ledger's own printed total (2,440.00, between double rules, crop-proved) AND the p3 county-form 'Subtotal for this page $2440.00' AND Box B 2,440.00. Box C 'Contributions Received Year to Date' also prints 2,440.00 — equal because this is the cycle's FIRST report, not because a cumulative figure was summed; it is retained and never added as an increment. NOTE the p3 'Total Contributions Received (Sum of all Schedule A pages)' line is PARTLY LOST IN REPRODUCTION (only a leading '2' and a trailing ',00' survive, the middle digits ghosted) — it is NOT quoted as a figure and was not used as an anchor.

itemized.notes: 2022 modern_boxAF filing, 8 PDF pages, every one read full-page at 200 dpi and classified from its OWN printed header: p1 COVER; p2 SUMMARY PAGE (found at p2, NOT the last page the modern variant usually puts it on — located by content); p3 county Schedule A form, grid EMPTY except the banner 'SEE ATTACHED' handwritten on printed row 1; p4 the filer's attached TYPED Schedule A ledger (23 rows, own printed total 2,440.00), hand-foliated 'PAGE 3a'; p5 county Schedule B form, grid EMPTY except the same 'SEE ATTACHED' banner on printed row 1; p6 the attached TYPED Schedule B ledger (9 rows, own printed total 2,354.50), hand-foliated 'PAGE 4a'; p7 the CAMPAIGN FINANCIAL DISCLOSURE CHECKLIST DECOY — the Website/Network/HOLD revision, two staff-signed review copies on one sheet (#1 in red ink dated '4/4/22', #2 in magenta dated '4/4/2022' — the second date crop-checked at 900 dpi, both digits the same open-top '4' this reviewer writes), zero dollar figures, born-digital clean; NOT a summary page; the Website / Network / HOLD boxes at its head are all UNTICKED;p8 a genuinely BLANK verso. THE BANNER 'SEE ATTACHED' IS AN ANNOTATION, NOT AN ENTRY — it publishes no row. The sides are nevertheless 'transcribed', not 'empty-schedule': what is missing on p3/p5 is the county's FORM grid being used, not the filer's entries (ADDENDUM A2/E5) — the entries are on pp4/6 and the county pages carry the matching printed subtotals. FORM: Schedule A columns are Date / Name of Contributor / Address and Zip Code / Amount with NO in-kind checkbox, the Summary's close box is UNLETTERED ('Balance at Close of Reporting Period (Box F - Box D)'), the cover offers FIVE report types, and the sheets foliate 'Date of Report / Page' 1,2,3,4 — i.e. the v.4.20-style carry-over blank of ADDENDUM J1, NOT the newer unversioned 2022 blank. Schedule B does print a real PURPOSE column and the attached ledger reproduces it, so purpose is captured on all 9 expenditure rows. PAGE FACE vs CHANNEL: the cover's Name of Candidate box is hand-printed 'RUDOLF LIVINGSTON' in block capitals and the affirmation line repeats 'RUDOLF LIVINGSTON'; index.csv carries the channel label 'Rudy Livingston'. THE PAGE FACE GOVERNS and the divergence is left visible. The Office box prints 'AUDITOR' (index: 'County Auditor'). REPORT TYPE: none of the five printed radio buttons is marked; the filer hand-wrote a tick and 'PRECEDING CONVENTION' in the margin to the right of '30 Days after the General Election'.
